design_description: A high-energy sky-blue and white camouflage-style design. The entire jersey uses an irregular abstract pattern made from fragmented, cloud-like shapes, with bright blue as the dominant colour and white breaking through organically across the shirt and sleeves. The pattern continues seamlessly across the front, back and sleeves, making the jersey feel like one continuous graphic rather than separate panels. There are no contrasting cuffs or side panels, keeping the construction intentionally simple. Dark navy is used for the main typography and sponsor elements, creating strong contrast against the light base. On the back, the large navy player name and number sit directly over the pattern, remaining highly legible despite the busy graphic. Overall, it is a bold three-colour concept, sky blue, white and navy, built around an all-over abstract camo/splatter pattern. Sporty, energetic and particularly distinctive from distance.
